verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents automations in the form of transaction rules and relayed authorisation, so asking whether those can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions rule version history, change review or approval workflows, or rollback to a prior configuration. Being able to create rules and configure fallback logic is a related but different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
